transcription_notes: Hand: CAM Cambridge Add.1570, 3-column book hand (Left -> Middle -> Right). BOUNDARY START: chapter 6 opens in the Left column at a red rubric '✣ ክፍል ፡ ፴ወ፭ ✣' (kefl 35) that carries a marginal chapter-marker 'ምዕ ፮' (=chapter 6) in the Left-Middle inter-column margin (located by vision at native y~3560); the narrative clause begins 'ወእምዝ' ('and it came to pass'). Everything above that in the Left column is chapter 5 (its tail '...ለሐኒፀ ፡ ቤት' precedes the rubric) and was NOT transcribed. The authoritative anchor is the marginal ምዕ ፮, aligned with the ክፍል ፴ወ፭ rubric. BOUNDARY STOP: chapter 6 ends in the Right column at the lone red numeral '፯' (7) on R-line 16 in the clause '...ወሐነፀ ፡ በ፯ ፡ ዓመት' ('and built it in seven years', =1Ki6:38). The word 'ዓመት' wraps onto the head of R-line 17; after it a gap then the FOLLOWING chapter opens 'ወሰሎሞን ፡ ሐነፀ ፡ ቤቶ ፡ በ፲ወ፫ ፡ ዓመት' (=1Ki7:1, red ፲ወ፫=13, new building subject) — NOT transcribed. COLUMN FLOW verified continuous at every turn (no skipped lines): Left foot '...ዳዊት ፡ አቡ|ከ' -> Middle top 'ከ ...' (the ከ is the tail of አቡከ, a normal word-split across the column turn); Middle foot '...ራግዘተ ፡ ፭ ፡ ወክልኤ' -> Right top 'ማዕያ ...'. Each column begins lower than the Left (Middle & Right first inked line ~y1820, with blank parchment above — confirmed by vision). DIVINE PROMISE (corrected R1, was previously mis-recorded as a recension minus): the canonical conditional promise (vv11-12, 'the word of the LORD came to Solomon... this house which thou buildest, if thou wilt walk in my statutes... I will perform my word with thee which I spake unto David thy father') IS PRESENT in clean ink on the Left-column foot, immediately after the inline red rubric '✣ ክፍል ፡ ፴ወ፭ ✣' (native y~7240-7990). It was an original column-foot transcriber SKIP in the blind pass, now RESTORED as witness v11 (ወኮነ ፡ ቃሉ ፡ እግዚእብሔር ፡ ኃበ ፡ ሰሎምን ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል) and v12 (ዝንቱ ፡ ቤት ... ምስለ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ አቡከ). The orphan ከ at the Middle-column top is NOT an omission residue: it is the tail of v12's final word አቡከ (a normal L->M word-split). Accordingly the witness now has 33 contiguous verses and witness v13 (ወአኃድር ፡ በማእከለ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ...) = canonical 1Ki6:13. DIVINE NAME: this folio's scribe writes the 1st-order form 'እግዚእብሔር' (1st-order initial እ + medial 1st-order እ) at every occurrence in the chapter, now FIVE: v1 ቤተ ፡ እግዚእብሔር; v2 ለእግዚእብሔር; the restored v11 ቃሉ ፡ እግዚእብሔር; witness-v17 ታቦተ ፡ ኪዳን ፡ እግዚእብሔር; witness-v31 ለቤተ ፡ እግዚእብሔር. The medial glyph is independently confirmed at high zoom as the twin-legged 1st-order እ (NOT the 4th-order አ bowl, which a 2.4-3x view falsely suggests); cross-checked against the same-hand 1ki5 CAM witness on this folio (እግዚእብሔር x7, እግዚአብሔር x0). Flagged 'uncertain' only as an honest zoom-resolution caution; reading firm. V10 FIX (R1): the blind pass had a phantom token ቅምዕ (no such word on the parchment) between ሐምስ and the cubit word, and read the cubit word as በእመቱ; both corrected on re-confirmation at native y~7110 — ቅምዕ deleted, በእመቱ -> በእመት (final 1st-order ት, matching every other በእመት in the chapter). ክፍል RUBRICS (red, fine liturgical subdivisions, NOT verse/chapter boundaries): '✣ ክፍል ፡ ፴ወ፭ ✣' (kefl 35) at the chapter opening (Left col, v1) and again before the divine promise on the Left-column foot; a further '✣ ክፍል ፡ ፴ ✣' appears in the Right column at witness-v30 (two lines above the ፯ chapter-end). The kefl count is non-monotonic across this folio's columns; segmentation follows the narrative sense-units (and the inline '✣' body-crosses), not the kefl rubrics. BODY CROSSES: inline '✣' (U+2723) divider-crosses kept inline at natural sense-breaks (the tokenizer strips them); one full-stop '።' divides within witness-v18 after the first altar clause. DAMAGE/FOXING: a diagonal brown foxing/stain band crosses the Right column at native y~3300-3700 (around/above the ✣ክፍል፴✣ rubric), spanning roughly R-lines 8-12 (witness-vv29-30 region). Text is readable but lower-contrast; read with a Pillow contrast boost and flagged 'damaged' where contrast was marginal. NUMERALS (red, small): v1 year is a red-marked composite read best as '፬፻ ፡ ወ፹' (the 480th year) but at the resolution limit (the hundreds glyph ፻ resembles የ in this hand) — flagged uncertain, not normalized. Other red cubit/count numerals (፷, ፳, ፴, ፵, ፪, ፭, ፩, ፲ወ፩, ፯) verified at zoom; small faint ones flagged. ANTI-HARMONIZATION WATCH: column-edge / line-end tokens (the L-foot->M-top junction, the M->R junction at witness-v25, the ፍ/numeral line-ends, the foxing-band words, the resolution-limited v12 verb ወአቀውም) were each re-read against the ink rather than smoothed to the expected printed form. Technical building/temple vocabulary (ለሜንትራ, ጻውቄና/ጳውቄማ, ዳቢር, ራግዘተ, ድርኩቱቶን, ገስፈ) transcribed as inked even where it diverges from a cleaner printed form. SEGMENTATION: 33 contiguous sense-unit verses (v=1..33) covering exactly the inked chapter-6 text; because the witness numbering is a continuous sense-unit run it does not map 1:1 onto the canonical 1..38 (per-verse comments record the canonical correspondence, e.g. witness v13 = canonical v13). RAM discipline: never loaded the whole folio uncropped; worked via Pillow crop()+downscale (<=1568px long edge) and native-resolution tight zooms for faded/numeral/edge tokens. C-6 R2 fix — v10: corrected ወአሰሬ/በማእሰሬ to the inked ወእስር/በማእስር (6th-order እ/ር), and restored the dropped column-foot clause ወእስር ፡ ለቤት ፡ በዕፀ ፡ አርዝ (canonical 6:10b cedar-fastening) present in clean ink before the ክፍል ፴ወ፭ rubric.
